weather.page_description: Near-term weather signals for demand and solar availability.
weather.hourly_detail_for_short_term_operational: Hourly detail for short-term operational analysis.
weather.daily_aggregates_for_broader_weather_tre: Daily aggregates for broader weather trends.
weather.no_additional_insight_for_this_forecast_: No additional insight for this forecast period.
weather.up_to_14_days_no_missing_values: Up to 14 days; no missing values are filled in.
weather.daily_minimum_average_and_maximum_c: Daily average temperature (°C). Minimum and maximum values and partial coverage are shown in the tooltip and table.
weather.daily_solar_energy_proxy_kwh_m: Daily solar-energy proxy (kWh/m²). Only complete daily totals are plotted.
weather.insight_disclaimer: Weather-derived indicators based on forecast conditions. They do not represent measured or forecast electricity consumption, generation, or market prices.
weather.no_daily_forecast_is_available_for_weath: No daily forecast is available for weather-derived insights.
weather.two_forecast_days_are_needed_to_compare: Two forecast days are needed to compare tomorrow with today.
weather.colder_conditions_may_increase_heating_d: Colder conditions may increase heating-driven electricity demand.
weather.cooling_driven_electricity_demand_condit: Cooling-driven electricity demand conditions may ease.
weather.warmer_conditions_may_increase_cooling_d: Warmer conditions may increase cooling-driven electricity demand.
weather.heating_driven_electricity_demand_condit: Heating-driven electricity demand conditions may ease.
weather.the_electricity_demand_implication_depen: The electricity-demand implication depends on heating and cooling needs.
weather.the_heating_cooling_demand_implication_d: The heating/cooling demand implication depends on local conditions.
weather.higher_irradiance_may_improve_conditions: Higher irradiance may improve conditions for solar PV generation.
weather.lower_irradiance_may_weaken_conditions_f: Lower irradiance may weaken conditions for solar PV generation.
weather.lower_irradiance_may_reduce_favorable_co: Lower irradiance may reduce favorable conditions for solar PV generation.
weather.indicating_potential_solar_pv_generation: indicating potential solar PV generation conditions
weather.indicating_favorable_irradiance_conditio: indicating favorable irradiance conditions for solar PV generation
weather.some_hourly_readings_are_missing_this_is: Some hourly readings are missing; this is the peak among available readings.
weather.some_day_on_day_insights_are_unavailable: Some day-on-day insights are unavailable because temperature or solar readings are missing. Available readings still support the displayed insights.
weather.no_large_day_on_day_temperature_or: No large day-on-day temperature or solar change is detected in the available forecast. This does not imply stable electricity demand, generation, or prices.
weather.colder_conditions_may_increase_heating_d: Colder conditions may increase heating-driven electricity demand while lower solar availability may weaken solar PV generation conditions. This is a qualitative weather outlook, not a price forecast.
weather.mild_temperatures_and_higher_solar_avail: Mild temperatures and higher solar availability may support more favorable weather-driven supply and demand conditions. Portfolio demand, generation, and prices are not predicted.
weather.no_qualifying_temperature_or_solar_trend: No qualifying temperature or solar trend was found across at least three consecutive complete forecast days. Missing or incomplete days can limit this comparison; this is not a demand, generation, or price forecast.
weather.average_temperature_is_expected_to_fall_: Average temperature is expected to fall {change}°C tomorrow.
weather.average_temperature_is_expected_to_rise_: Average temperature is expected to rise {change}°C tomorrow.
weather.solar_energy_proxy_on_date_falls_change: Solar-energy proxy on {date} falls {change} kWh/m² versus {baseline}.
weather.solar_energy_proxy_on_date_rises_change: Solar-energy proxy on {date} rises {change} kWh/m² versus {baseline}.
weather.daily_average_temperature_changes_by_cha: Daily average temperature changes by {change}°C from {start} through {end} across consecutive forecast days.
weather.the_daily_solar_energy_proxy_changes_by: The daily solar-energy proxy changes by {change} kWh/m² from {start} through {end} across consecutive forecast days.
weather.solar_irradiance_on_date_is_forecast_to: Solar irradiance on {date} is forecast to peak around {time} at {peak} W/m², {conditions}. The time marks the end of the one-hour interval and is local to the forecast location.
weather.solar_irradiance_is_the_amount_of_solar: Solar irradiance is the amount of solar power reaching a square metre of horizontal surface, measured in W/m². Higher values generally indicate stronger sunlight and more favorable conditions for solar PV (which is a technology that converts light directly into electricity) generation. It is a weather indicator of solar generation potential, not actual PV generation
weather.total_solar_energy_received_per_square_m: Total solar energy received per square metre over the day, derived from forecast solar irradiance. Higher values generally indicate more favorable conditions for solar PV generation. This is a weather-based proxy, not actual PV generation.
weather.the_highest_forecast_solar_irradiance_du: The highest forecast solar irradiance during the day, measured in W/m², followed by the local time ending that one-hour interval. It indicates when solar generation conditions are expected to be strongest.
weather.wind_explanation: Wind speed at 120 m serves as a qualitative proxy for typical hub-height conditions, not an asset-level generation forecast. Commercial turbines generally start producing around 3–4 m/s (cut-in), reach peak rated capacity around 15 m/s, and shut down above ~25 m/s (cut-out) for structural safety.
weather.wind_hourly_description: Forecast wind at 120 m (m/s). Gaps indicate missing readings.
weather.wind_missing: Wind data unavailable for this period.
weather.wind_daily_description: Daily average wind speed at 120 m (m/s). Minimum and maximum values and partial coverage are shown in the tooltip and table.
weather.daily_wind_from: Wind from {direction}. Arrow points toward the source of the wind.
weather.wind_trend_detail: Average wind at 120 m changes by {change} m/s from {start} through {end} across sustained forecast periods. {implication} Wind speed indicates generation conditions, not actual production.
weather.wind_low_detail: Average wind at 120 m remains below {speed} m/s for {duration} forecast {unit} from {start} through {end}. Low wind may limit favorable wind generation conditions.
weather.wind_direction_detail: Consistent wind-from bearings shift by {change}° from {startDirection}° on {start} to {endDirection}° on {end} at 120 m. Direction changes may alter local wind generation conditions; output depends on turbine and site characteristics.
weather.wind_combined_detail: From {start} through {end}, average temperature falls from {startTemp} to {endTemp}°C alongside low solar availability and average wind below {speed} m/s. Heating-related demand may rise while renewable generation conditions weaken; actual demand, production and prices are not predicted.
weather.wind_named_direction_detail: The prevailing wind direction at 120 m shifts by {change}°, from {startName} ({startDirection}°) in the forecast period starting at {start} to {endName} ({endDirection}°) in the period starting at {end}. This may influence local wind generation depending on turbine layout and site conditions.
weather.wind_increasing_implication: Increasing wind speeds may improve conditions for wind power generation.
weather.wind_decreasing_implication: Decreasing wind speeds may reduce favorable conditions for wind power generation.
weather.chart_no_measurements: No measurements available for this period.
weather.card_incomplete_average: Incomplete data · {available}/{expected} hours. Average based on available readings.
weather.card_incomplete_solar: Incomplete data · {available}/{expected} hours. Daily energy total may be underestimated.
weather.tooltip_missing_measurements: Some recorded hours have no valid readings for this metric.
